verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is language-agnostic (scans raw text/files, git history, Docker images, filesystems, chats, wikis, etc.) so it inherently covers code in any programming language, but there is no evidence of package-ecosystem-aware scanning (e.g., parsing npm/pip/maven manifests) — its 'coverage' claims are about 800+ secret types and source platforms, not languages or package managers.
